##### Project general facts

Orra The Embankment by Prestige One Developments is a stunning landmark residential tower that brings a bold new expression of luxury living to life. Rising with a striking, contemporary silhouette, it stands as a distinctive destination crafted for those who appreciate refined and elevated lifestyles. The development offers an impressive variety of thoughtfully designed homes, ranging from studios and one- to five-bedroom apartments to superior hotel apartments, luxury residences, and exclusive penthouses.

Orra The Embankment has been meticulously planned to deliver a resort-style lifestyle right at home. Residents can unwind at the spectacular infinity deck pool and jacuzzi, stay active on the professional basketball multipurpose court, and enjoy a dedicated synthetic jogging track. Every amenity has been curated to blend relaxation and recreation, creating a vibrant community where wellness and leisure come together beautifully.

The interiors at Orra The Embankment tell a powerful story of luxury through their elegant, contemporary design language. Each residence showcases exquisite designer finishes, spacious bedrooms with private ensuite baths, and expansive glazing that fills every space with light and breathtaking panoramic views. Large sundeck balconies extend the living areas outdoors, while beautifully appointed kitchens and premium fittings elevate everyday living to an extraordinary level.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT) is a dynamic and upscale mixed-use development situated in the heart of "New Dubai," a thriving district that has experienced rapid growth and development in recent years. JLT is known for its iconic cluster of high-rise towers, stunning lakes, and well-planned infrastructure.

One of the standout features of Jumeirah Lake Towers is the presence of four man-made lakes, which serve as a central feature of the development. These picturesque lakes provide a serene environment and offer stunning views for the residents and visitors. Surrounding the lakes, there are beautifully landscaped gardens and walkways that enhance the overall ambiance.

JLT is a sought-after destination for professionals and families due to its strategic location and excellent connectivity. It is located close to major highways and well-connected to the Dubai Metro network, providing easy access to other parts of the city. The development is also in proximity to popular leisure and entertainment destinations, including Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and Dubai Media City.
